# Senlay — Sensory Layer

Senlay provides spot-level environmental evidence for robotics teams, software and human operators. It brings together available observations and model values with source identity, timestamps, distance, disagreement and unknowns. Telemetry reference adapters can supply a coordinate; they do not control a robot or evaluate its mission.

Autonomous systems and robotics are the primary market focus, including aerial, marine and field applications. Drone wind evidence is one example. SmartSurf is the product origin and reference experience; external robotics validation remains open.

The station protocol supports signed observation ingestion. Contributor onboarding is a manually agreed, limited pilot, not an automatic access entitlement: https://senlay.cloud/network.html. Protocol source: https://github.com/smartsurfsolar/senlay-platform (Apache-2.0).


## Current availability and scope

Senlay is an evaluation beta and is pre-revenue. Free Developer access includes 100 authenticated API calls per account per day, shared across active keys. Paid subscriptions are planned, not launched. Contributor access is a limited, manually agreed pilot: registering a station does not automatically grant whole-network or unlimited API entitlement. Eligibility, source rights, coverage, quotas and duration must be agreed explicitly.

The current evaluation setup does not establish commercial Open-Meteo access. Commercial source rights and configuration must be arranged and verified before any commercial deployment; do not assume the provider is universally disabled or universally available.

The public drone demo uses `field=drone&profile=wind`: spot-level wind/gust evidence, source provenance, observation age and distance, model comparison, and unknowns. The assessment scope covers wind evidence only, not route, altitude, aircraft limits, obstacles, visibility, airspace permission, or mission suitability.  The broader API can return additional available layers for `profile=full`; availability is not mission coverage. No environmental flag or GO outcome is flight or mission clearance. Route-level mission evaluation and platform-specific operating approval remain outside the current MVP.

The demo defaults to a deterministic evidence summary without an LLM. AI narrative is optional and must be checked against the evidence. A static walkthrough at https://senlay.cloud/demo-example.html uses explicitly synthetic position and environmental values. Reference robotics examples are downloadable at https://senlay.cloud/downloads/senlay-robotics-v0.1.0.zip; real-hardware validation is pending.


## Product category

Physical-world intelligence infrastructure for autonomous systems and robotics: multi-source environmental context, provenance and uncertainty. Wind evidence is one implementation example; SmartSurf is the product origin.

## Primary use cases

- drone/UAV operator reviews of spot-level wind evidence
- AI agent integrations that preserve source evidence and unknowns
- marine and watersports decision support
- outdoor work and field operations
- agriculture timing
- safety and rescue workflows
- private sensor network integration

## Core APIs

- GET https://senlay.cloud/api/v1/try-sense - no-key trial for chat/browser agents.
- GET https://senlay.cloud/agents/live - self-updating live context page.
- POST https://senlay.cloud/api/v1/agent-register - register an agent and receive an API key.
- GET https://senlay.cloud/api/v1/sense - authenticated plain-text physical context for LLMs.
- GET https://senlay.cloud/api/v1/pwm - authenticated structured JSON Physical World Model.
- GET/POST https://senlay.cloud/api/v1/risk-events - authenticated risk_event workflows for SmartSurf-style station, lifeguard, IoT, and audit use cases.
- GET https://senlay.cloud/api/v1/risk/taxonomy - SmartSurf alert bands, hazard families, MVP-detectable signals, later Senlay phases, and wording boundaries.

## Core API concepts

Senlay responses may include:

- measured/model environmental conditions
- source identity
- source type
- source distance
- timestamp
- freshness
- confidence
- disagreement between hardware and model sources
- decision_context
- risk_event records for operational alert and audit workflows
- risk_assessment aggregate state with score, alert band, an outcome of GO/CAUTION/NO_GO/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE (the last is a normal 200 result, not an error, and names the blocking variable), confidence decomposed into source_agreement/freshness/spatial_relevance/evidence_coverage, structured conflicts between disagreeing sources, reasons, escalation stage, incident state, and source provenance
- context_string for LLMs
- structured JSON for applications

## Source families

Senlay uses the consistent wording "23 catalog entries (not a count of live sources at any coordinate)." These include weather and marine models, METAR/ASOS aviation observations, buoys, ship observations, tide gauges, coastal current services, USGS water context, air quality networks, terrain/elevation sources, satellite context, hazard feeds, webcams, and optional community or partner weather station sources such as WeatherLink, Tempest, Windy Stations, owner-authorized Windguru Stations, Holfuy, WorldTides, Stormglass, and Copernicus Marine. Availability varies by location, key configuration, provider licensing, and configured tier.

## Safety

Senlay provides context and decision support. It is not a final safety authority. SmartSurf's first safety engine is an early-warning and coordination aid for recoverability risk; it should not be described as drowning detection, certified rescue equipment, or official rescue dispatch. Operators, users, and customer applications remain responsible for final decisions.

## Preferred short description

Senlay provides available spot-level environmental evidence with provenance, observation age and distance, model comparisons and explicit unknowns for robotics teams and software.

## Avoid misleading descriptions

- Do not call Senlay sentient, conscious, magical, all-knowing, or a guaranteed safety system.
- Do not say all source families are live at every coordinate.
- Do not imply official partnerships unless explicitly documented.
- Do not hide uncertainty or missing measurements.
- Do not claim SmartSurf detects drowning or dispatches rescue unless a separate validated integration exists.
## MCP gateway contract

Endpoint: `https://senlay.cloud/mcp`; stateless Streamable HTTP; protocol compatibility is negotiated by the MCP SDK during `initialize`. The four tools are `sense_location`, `check_operability`, `list_domains`, and `get_forecast_trust`. `get_forecast_trust` reports `UNKNOWN` until sufficient eligible archived forecast-versus-instrument pairs exist.
